location.value: A Rare Address Between Park And Canal
Beside Al Safa Park and along the Dubai Water Canal, Eden House The Park brings a quieter residential setting to the heart of Dubai, with the city's most established destinations within easy reach.
Map showing Eden House The Park and nearby destinations

payment.value: Favourable Payment Plan For A Distinctive Home

about.value: H&H — A Legacy Of Design Excellence

items.text: Established in Dubai in 2007, H&H is a developer and asset manager recognised for its commitment to exceptional craftsmanship, architectural integrity and enduring quality. Its distinguished portfolio includes collaborations with globally renowned names such as Four Seasons, Aman and Rosewood, alongside its own residential hospitality brand, Eden House. Through a carefully curated approach to development, H&H continues to create distinctive addresses that bring together design, quality and a refined way of living.
